Category query

API for querying categories created in [Basic Information Management] - [Customer Category Settings].

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/CategoryList.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required cate_type string Category type selection Allowed values
  1. - 001 : Own category list
3. Lcate_nm string Level 1 category name Enter a level 1 category name to show its subcategories
4. Lcate_id string Level 1 category code Enter a level 1 category code to show its subcategories

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<categoryInfo>
		<Category>
			<customer_id>a0000001</customer_id>
			<cate_type>p_56438</cate_type>
			<Lcate_nm>생활/건강</Lcate_nm>
			<Lcate_id>AK002</Lcate_id>
		</Category>
	</categoryInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. group_cate_nm string Category group name
2. group_cate_code string Category group code
3. CategoryDetailT string Category information
4. LCategory string Level 1 category
5. MCategory string Level 2 category
6. SCategory string Level 3 category
7. DCategory string Level 4 category
